s.note: the Angels game where Frank calls the plays
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss with a teaspoon of fine salt while still hot. Divide between four paper bags and leave an empty bowl for the shells.

Simmer 8 franks for 5 minutes, then griddle until blistered. Steam 8 hot dog buns over the pot for 1 minute. Load each with a frank, yellow mustard and sweet relish and wrap in paper like the ballpark.

m.how: Brown 400g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 tsp chilli powder, add 1 tin tomatoes and simmer 45 minutes. Griddle 8 franks. Put in steamed buns, spoon over chilli and top with 100g grated cheddar and diced onion.

w.n: Ninth inning malt and fudge ice cream cups
w.how: Soften 1 litre vanilla ice cream for 10 minutes. Heat 100ml cream until steaming and stir in 100g dark chocolate and 1 tbsp golden syrup until smooth, then cool. Ripple half the fudge through the ice cream with 80g crushed chocolate honeycomb and refreeze 1 hour. Scoop into 4 paper cups, spoon over the rest of the warm fudge and scatter with salted peanuts.

d.how: Make syrup by dissolving 100g caster sugar in 100ml hot water and cool. Blend the syrup with 150ml fresh lemon juice, 160ml vodka, 200ml cold water and 4 cups of ice for 30 seconds until slushy. Pour into 4 cups, garnish with lemon wheels and serve with straws.
